blocks.zh: 附錄 20 品質風險管理 — 第 B 部分：方法、工具與應用範例
blocks.en: Annex 20 Quality Risk Management — Part B: Methods, Tools and Application Examples

blocks.zh: 學習目標 Learning Objectives
blocks.en: Learning Objectives

blocks.zh: 掌握七種主要 QRM 工具（FMEA、FMECA、FTA、HACCP、HAZOP、PHA、風險排序）的原理、輸出與使用場景
blocks.en: Understand the principles, outputs and use cases of the seven main QRM tools (FMEA, FMECA, FTA, HACCP, HAZOP, PHA, risk ranking and filtering)

blocks.zh: 理解輔助統計工具（管制圖、製程能力分析、DOE）如何支持品質風險管理決策
blocks.en: Understand how supporting statistical tools (control charts, process capability analysis, DOE) support quality risk management decisions

blocks.zh: 能夠依照 GMP 活動類型（開發、生產、設施、物料、包裝）選擇適當的 QRM 工具組合
blocks.en: Be able to select an appropriate combination of QRM tools by type of GMP activity (development, manufacturing, facilities, materials, packaging)

blocks.zh: 在 CDMO 無菌製劑稽查背景下，辨識最常被查核的 QRM 應用場景，並準備合規回應
blocks.en: In the context of CDMO sterile product inspections, identify the QRM applications most often examined and prepare compliant responses

blocks.zh: Annex I — Risk Management Methods and Tools 風險管理方法與工具
blocks.en: Annex I — Risk Management Methods and Tools

blocks.zh: I.1 Basic Risk Management Facilitation Methods — 基礎風險管理輔助方法
blocks.en: I.1 Basic Risk Management Facilitation Methods

blocks.zh: 中文解析 — 基礎輔助工具
blocks.en: Commentary — Basic Facilitation Tools

blocks.zh: 這些工具做什麼？
blocks.en: What do these tools do?

blocks.zh: 這類工具本身不是「風險評估工具」，而是用來組織資料、結構化思考，為後續更深度的風險分析（如 FMEA、HAZOP）打好基礎。
blocks.en: These tools are not "risk assessment tools" in themselves. They are used to organize data and structure thinking, laying the groundwork for deeper risk analysis later (such as FMEA or HAZOP).

blocks.zh: 流程圖（Flowchart）：視覺化整個製程，讓每個步驟、決策點都清楚可見
blocks.en: Flowchart: visualizes the whole process so that every step and decision point is clearly visible

blocks.zh: 查核表（Check Sheet）：系統性地記錄數據或異常事件的頻率
blocks.en: Check Sheet: systematically records data or the frequency of abnormal events

blocks.zh: 製程圖（Process Mapping）：比流程圖更詳細，標出物料流、資訊流與人員流
blocks.en: Process Mapping: more detailed than a flowchart; shows material flow, information flow and personnel flow

blocks.zh: 魚骨圖（Ishikawa / Cause & Effect）：用來集體腦力激盪，識別一個問題的所有可能原因
blocks.en: Ishikawa / Cause & Effect diagram: used for group brainstorming to identify all possible causes of a problem

blocks.zh: CDMO 實務類比
blocks.en: CDMO practice analogy

blocks.zh: 在處理一個灌裝缺陷的 CAPA 時，QA 團隊通常先用魚骨圖腦力激盪所有可能原因（設備、人員、物料、環境、方法），再選擇 FMEA 或 FTA 做深度分析。兩步走，不走彎路。
blocks.en: When handling a CAPA for a filling defect, the QA team typically starts with a fishbone diagram to brainstorm all possible causes (equipment, people, materials, environment, methods), and then selects FMEA or FTA for in-depth analysis. Two steps, no detours.

blocks.zh: I.2 Failure Mode Effects Analysis (FMEA) — 失效模式與影響分析
blocks.en: I.2 Failure Mode Effects Analysis (FMEA)

blocks.zh: 中文解析 — FMEA
blocks.en: Commentary — FMEA

blocks.zh: FMEA 核心邏輯：三問
blocks.en: The core logic of FMEA: three questions

blocks.zh: 每一個製程步驟或設備功能，都問三個問題：
blocks.en: For every process step or equipment function, ask three questions:

blocks.zh: 什麼會失效？（Failure Mode） — 例如：過濾器堵塞、注射針頭偏移
blocks.en: What can fail? (Failure Mode) — e.g., filter clogging, filling needle misalignment

blocks.zh: 失效後影響什麼？（Effect） — 例如：批次報廢、污染風險
blocks.en: What is the impact of the failure? (Effect) — e.g., batch rejection, contamination risk

blocks.zh: 為什麼失效？（Cause） — 例如：濾材老化、機械磨損
blocks.en: Why does it fail? (Cause) — e.g., aged filter media, mechanical wear

blocks.zh: FMECA 延伸：RPN 公式
blocks.en: FMECA extension: the RPN formula

blocks.zh:
RPN = Severity (S) × Occurrence (O) × Detection (D)
      嚴重度 ×  發生頻率  ×   可偵測性

RPN 越高 → 風險越大 → 優先列入 CAPA
blocks.en:
RPN = Severity (S) × Occurrence (O) × Detection (D)
      severity   ×  occurrence  ×  detectability

Higher RPN → greater risk → higher CAPA priority

blocks.zh: 注意：FMECA 是 FMEA 的延伸版本，加入了嚴重度等級（Criticality）的量化評分，產出相對風險分數，用於排序優先改善項目。
blocks.en: Note: FMECA is an extension of FMEA that adds quantitative scoring of severity (criticality) levels. It produces a relative risk score used to prioritize improvement items.

blocks.zh: FMEA 的輸出
blocks.en: Outputs of FMEA

blocks.zh: 失效模式清單（含優先排序）
blocks.en: A list of failure modes (with prioritization)

blocks.zh: 每個失效的建議控制措施
blocks.en: Recommended control measures for each failure

blocks.zh: CAPA 優先序（依 RPN 排列）
blocks.en: CAPA priorities (ranked by RPN)

blocks.zh: 可作為設計檢討或製程驗證的依據文件
blocks.en: Documentation that can serve as the basis for design review or process validation

blocks.zh: CDMO 思考題
blocks.en: CDMO discussion question

blocks.zh: 當 CDMO QA 團隊接到客戶的新劑型技術轉移案，他們通常如何決定是用 FMEA 還是 HAZOP？
blocks.en: When a CDMO QA team receives a customer's technology transfer project for a new dosage form, how do they usually decide between FMEA and HAZOP?

blocks.zh: 一般原則：FMEA 適合元件層級的系統性分析（例如灌裝機各個機構），而 HAZOP 適合製程流程中的偏差識別（例如 WFI 系統操作條件偏離）。新設備導入或製程設計早期常見 FMEA；現有製程改變參數時常用 HAZOP。
blocks.en: General principle: FMEA suits systematic analysis at the component level (e.g., the individual mechanisms of a filling machine), while HAZOP suits identifying deviations in the process flow (e.g., operating conditions of a WFI system drifting out of range). FMEA is common when introducing new equipment or in early process design; HAZOP is often used when parameters of an existing process are changed.

blocks.zh: I.3 Failure Mode, Effects and Criticality Analysis (FMECA) — 失效模式、影響與嚴重度分析
blocks.en: I.3 Failure Mode, Effects and Criticality Analysis (FMECA)

blocks.zh: 中文解析 — FMECA
blocks.en: Commentary — FMECA

blocks.zh: 實務提醒
blocks.en: Practical reminder

blocks.zh: 在 CDMO 環境中，客戶合約常要求對灌裝線的 CCP（關鍵控制點）進行 FMECA。稽查員可能要求查看 RPN 評分紀錄，並確認評分標準（scoring criteria）已書面化且一致應用。
blocks.en: In a CDMO setting, customer contracts often require an FMECA of the critical control points (CCPs) on the filling line. Inspectors may ask to see the RPN scoring records and confirm that the scoring criteria are documented and applied consistently.

blocks.zh: I.4 Fault Tree Analysis (FTA) — 故障樹分析
blocks.en: I.4 Fault Tree Analysis (FTA)

blocks.zh: 中文解析 — FTA
blocks.en: Commentary — FTA

blocks.zh: FTA 的「由上而下」邏輯
blocks.en: The "top-down" logic of FTA

blocks.zh: FTA 與 FMEA 方向相反：
blocks.en: FTA runs in the opposite direction to FMEA:

blocks.zh: FMEA：由下而上 — 從個別失效模式 → 推算對系統的影響
blocks.en: FMEA: bottom-up — starts from individual failure modes and works out their effect on the system

blocks.zh: FTA：由上而下 — 從一個已知的「頂部事件（Top Event）」（如：批次污染）→ 往下拆解所有可能導致此結果的原因鏈
blocks.en: FTA: top-down — starts from a known "Top Event" (e.g., batch contamination) and breaks down the chain of all possible causes leading to that outcome

blocks.zh: 比喻：故障樹像一棵倒置的樹
blocks.en: Analogy: a fault tree is an upside-down tree

blocks.zh: 頂端是「問題結果」（例如：培養基灌裝汙染），分支往下是各種原因（AND / OR 邏輯）。AND 閘代表兩個條件同時發生才會導致問題；OR 閘代表任一條件即可。這讓分析人員清楚看到哪些「多因共存」路徑風險最高。
blocks.en: The top is the "problem outcome" (e.g., contamination of a media fill), and the branches below are the various causes (AND / OR logic). An AND gate means two conditions must occur together to cause the problem; an OR gate means either condition alone is enough. This lets the analyst see clearly which "multiple causes co-existing" paths carry the highest risk.

blocks.zh: FTA 在 CDMO 偏差調查中的應用
blocks.en: Use of FTA in CDMO deviation investigations

blocks.zh: 當一個無菌測試失敗（Sterility Test Failure, STF）事件發生，FTA 可系統性地追溯到根本原因，並確認改善措施能真正斷開故障路徑，而非只解決一個表面症狀卻讓另一個問題浮現。稽查員特別欣賞用 FTA 記錄的偏差調查報告，因為它直觀且具說服力。
blocks.en: When a sterility test failure (STF) occurs, FTA can systematically trace back to the root cause and confirm that the corrective actions truly break the failure path, rather than fixing one surface symptom while letting another problem emerge. Inspectors particularly appreciate deviation investigation reports documented with FTA because they are intuitive and persuasive.

blocks.zh: 一條新的 RTU 預充填針劑灌裝線正在做設備確認（IQ/OQ），何時適合用 FMEA，何時適合用 FTA？
blocks.en: A new RTU prefilled syringe filling line is undergoing equipment qualification (IQ/OQ). When is FMEA appropriate and when is FTA appropriate?

blocks.zh: 建議答案：IQ/OQ 設計階段用 FMEA（預防性，識別各元件潛在失效）；若 OQ 期間發生 OOS 異常，則用 FTA 做根因調查（反應性，從問題回溯原因）。
blocks.en: Suggested answer: Use FMEA at the IQ/OQ design stage (preventive; identifies potential failures of each component). If an OOS anomaly occurs during OQ, use FTA for root cause investigation (reactive; works back from the problem to its causes).

blocks.zh: I.5 Hazard Analysis and Critical Control Points (HACCP) — 危害分析與關鍵控制點
blocks.en: I.5 Hazard Analysis and Critical Control Points (HACCP)

blocks.zh: 中文解析 — HACCP
blocks.en: Commentary — HACCP

blocks.zh: HACCP 起源與製藥應用
blocks.en: Origins of HACCP and its pharmaceutical application

blocks.zh: HACCP 最初由食品業（NASA 太空食品計畫）發展，後被製藥業採用。其核心是預防性控制而非事後測試——在製程關鍵點建立可量化的限制，並即時監控。
blocks.en: HACCP was originally developed in the food industry (the NASA space food program) and later adopted by the pharmaceutical industry. Its core is preventive control rather than after-the-fact testing: establish measurable limits at critical points in the process and monitor them in real time.

blocks.zh: CCP（Critical Control Point）：製程中一個可以施加控制措施的環節，若失控則直接危害產品安全或品質。
blocks.en: CCP (Critical Control Point): a point in the process where a control measure can be applied and where loss of control directly endangers product safety or quality.

blocks.zh: Critical Limit（關鍵限制值）：CCP 的量化邊界，例如：滅菌溫度 ≥ 121°C 維持 15 分鐘。
blocks.en: Critical Limit: the quantitative boundary of a CCP, for example: sterilization temperature ≥ 121°C held for 15 minutes.

blocks.zh: HACCP 和 FMEA 都能用於無菌灌裝風險管理，那 CDMO QA 如何選擇？
blocks.en: Both HACCP and FMEA can be used for aseptic filling risk management, so how does CDMO QA choose?

blocks.zh: 建議答案：HACCP 著重預防性監控與即時控制（適合定義 CCP 並建立警戒 / 行動限值體系）；FMEA 著重系統性失效識別與優先排序（適合設備設計或製程開發階段）。兩者可互補使用。
blocks.en: Suggested answer: HACCP emphasizes preventive monitoring and real-time control (suited to defining CCPs and establishing an alert / action limit system); FMEA emphasizes systematic failure identification and prioritization (suited to equipment design or process development). The two can be used in a complementary way.

blocks.zh: I.6 Hazard and Operability Study (HAZOP) — 危害與操作性分析
blocks.en: I.6 Hazard and Operability Study (HAZOP)

blocks.zh: 中文解析 — HAZOP
blocks.en: Commentary — HAZOP

blocks.zh: HAZOP 的核心：引導詞（Guide Words）
blocks.en: The core of HAZOP: Guide Words

blocks.zh: HAZOP 的精髓是用「引導詞」系統性地質疑每個製程參數，看看「如果這個參數偏離了設計意圖，會發生什麼？」
blocks.en: The essence of HAZOP is to use "guide words" to systematically challenge every process parameter and ask "what happens if this parameter deviates from the design intent?"

blocks.zh: HAZOP 需要跨部門團隊
blocks.en: HAZOP requires a cross-functional team

blocks.zh: HAZOP 不是一個人能做的分析。理想的 HAZOP 團隊包括：製程工程師、QA、設備維護、操作員代表，有時還有客戶（在 CDMO 場景下）。多元觀點是識別「設計者沒想到的偏差」的關鍵。
blocks.en: HAZOP is not an analysis one person can do. An ideal HAZOP team includes a process engineer, QA, equipment maintenance and an operator representative, and sometimes the customer (in a CDMO setting). Diverse perspectives are the key to identifying "deviations the designer did not think of".

blocks.zh: 一個 CDMO 準備對新建的 WFI 配製系統做風險評估，應選 HAZOP 還是 FMEA？
blocks.en: A CDMO is preparing a risk assessment of a newly built WFI preparation system. Should it choose HAZOP or FMEA?

blocks.zh: 建議答案：兩者都可，但 HAZOP 更適合「操作條件偏差」的系統性識別（如流量、壓力、溫度偏離），尤其是當設計圖（P&ID）已完成時。FMEA 則更適合在設計圖完成前，對個別元件（泵、過濾器、閥門）做失效分析。實務上常先做 HAZOP 找出危害，再用 FMEA 評估各失效模式的 RPN。
blocks.en: Suggested answer: Either can be used, but HAZOP is better for systematically identifying "operating condition deviations" (such as flow, pressure and temperature excursions), especially once the design drawings (P&ID) are complete. FMEA is better before the design drawings are complete, for failure analysis of individual components (pumps, filters, valves). In practice, HAZOP is often done first to identify hazards, and FMEA is then used to evaluate the RPN of each failure mode.

blocks.zh: I.7 Preliminary Hazard Analysis (PHA) — 初步危害分析
blocks.en: I.7 Preliminary Hazard Analysis (PHA)

blocks.zh: 中文解析 — PHA
blocks.en: Commentary — PHA

blocks.zh: PHA：最早期的風險快照
blocks.en: PHA: the earliest risk snapshot

blocks.zh: PHA 是在「還沒有完整設計細節」時使用的工具。它的目標不是深度分析，而是快速識別主要危害，讓後續更精細的工具有焦點可以深入。
blocks.en: PHA is a tool used when "complete design details are not yet available". Its goal is not deep analysis but to quickly identify the main hazards so that later, more detailed tools have a focus to dig into.

blocks.zh: 適用時機：
blocks.en: When to use it:

blocks.zh: 新設施 / 新生產線的概念設計階段
blocks.en: Concept design stage of a new facility / new production line

blocks.zh: 新製程引進評估（可行性研究）
blocks.en: Evaluation of introducing a new process (feasibility study)

blocks.zh: 當時間或資源不足以做完整 HAZOP / FMEA 時的快速初篩
blocks.en: Quick initial screening when time or resources are insufficient for a full HAZOP / FMEA

blocks.zh: PHA 四步驟比喻
blocks.en: The four PHA steps, by analogy

blocks.zh: 想像你在評估一棟新廠房是否適合做高活性原料藥（HAPI）處理：
blocks.en: Imagine you are evaluating whether a new building is suitable for handling highly potent active pharmaceutical ingredients (HPAPI):

blocks.zh: 識別危害：暴露風險、洩漏風險、交叉污染風險
blocks.en: Identify hazards: exposure risk, leakage risk, cross-contamination risk

blocks.zh: 質性評估：如果洩漏，人員傷害嚴重度是高 / 中 / 低？
blocks.en: Qualitative assessment: if there is a leak, is the severity of personnel injury high / medium / low?

blocks.zh: 相對排序：用 2×2 矩陣（嚴重度 × 可能性）快速排出優先項
blocks.en: Relative ranking: use a 2×2 matrix (severity × likelihood) to quickly rank priorities

blocks.zh: 初步對策：獨立廠房、負壓設計、PPE 要求
blocks.en: Preliminary countermeasures: dedicated building, negative pressure design, PPE requirements

blocks.zh: 這個快速評估結果，之後再交給 HAZOP 或 FMEA 做深度分析。
blocks.en: The result of this quick assessment is then handed to HAZOP or FMEA for in-depth analysis.

blocks.zh: PHA 是「前驅工具」
blocks.en: PHA is a "precursor tool"

blocks.zh: PHA 識別出的危害，通常會進一步使用 FMEA、HAZOP 或 HACCP 做更精細的評估。PHA 本身不替代這些工具，而是讓後續分析更有效率、更聚焦。
blocks.en: The hazards identified by PHA are usually evaluated further in more detail using FMEA, HAZOP or HACCP. PHA does not replace these tools; it makes the subsequent analysis more efficient and more focused.

blocks.zh: I.8 Risk Ranking and Filtering — 風險排序與篩選
blocks.en: I.8 Risk Ranking and Filtering

blocks.zh: 中文解析 — 風險排序與篩選
blocks.en: Commentary — Risk Ranking and Filtering

blocks.zh: 什麼是風險篩選（Filtering）？
blocks.en: What is risk filtering?

blocks.zh: 「篩選」是指設定一個門檻（cut-off）或加權方式，讓組織可以依照政策目標決定哪些風險必須優先處理，哪些可以接受現狀管理。
blocks.en: "Filtering" means setting a threshold (cut-off) or weighting method so that the organization can decide, in line with policy objectives, which risks must be addressed first and which can be managed under current practice.

blocks.zh: 例如：在 CDMO 的年度供應商審核計畫中，可以對每個供應商打分數（分數由多個維度加權而來），再依分數高低決定稽查頻率——高風險供應商每年稽查，中風險兩年一次，低風險只做書面評估。
blocks.en: For example: in a CDMO's annual supplier audit program, each supplier can be given a score (weighted from multiple dimensions), and the audit frequency is then set by score — high-risk suppliers are audited every year, medium-risk every two years, and low-risk suppliers receive only a paper assessment.

blocks.zh: 風險矩陣（Risk Matrix）的局限
blocks.en: Limitations of the risk matrix

blocks.zh: 最常見的風險排序工具是 2×2 或 3×3 風險矩陣（嚴重度 × 發生頻率）。但矩陣只考慮兩個維度，適合初步篩選。對於複雜場景（如多產品 CDMO 的交叉污染評估），需要引入更多維度（如可偵測性、暴露時間、控制措施有效性），這就是「多因子風險分數」的用武之地。
blocks.en: The most common risk ranking tool is the 2×2 or 3×3 risk matrix (severity × occurrence). However, a matrix considers only two dimensions and is suited to initial screening. Complex scenarios (such as cross-contamination assessment in a multi-product CDMO) require additional dimensions (such as detectability, exposure time and effectiveness of controls), which is where a "multi-factor risk score" comes in.

blocks.zh: 一家 CDMO 有 150 個原物料供應商，QA 主管如何用風險排序決定今年哪 20 家優先現場稽查？
blocks.en: A CDMO has 150 raw material suppliers. How can the QA head use risk ranking to decide which 20 get priority on-site audits this year?

blocks.zh: 建議答案：建立多維度評分模型（例如：物料類別嚴重性 × 供應商稽查歷史 × 前次 OOS 頻率 × 市場唯一性 × 交貨準時率），每個維度給予不同權重，加總後排序。分數最高的 20 家列入當年度現場稽查名單，其餘以問卷或書面審查取代。
blocks.en: Suggested answer: Build a multi-dimensional scoring model (for example: material category criticality × supplier audit history × frequency of previous OOS × sole-source status × on-time delivery rate), assign each dimension a different weight, and rank by the total. The 20 highest-scoring suppliers go on this year's on-site audit list, and the rest are covered by questionnaires or document review instead.

blocks.zh: I.9 Supporting Statistical Tools — 輔助統計工具
blocks.en: I.9 Supporting Statistical Tools

blocks.zh: 中文解析 — 統計輔助工具
blocks.en: Commentary — Supporting Statistical Tools

blocks.zh: 統計工具在 QRM 中的角色
blocks.en: The role of statistical tools in QRM

blocks.zh: 統計工具本身不是風險評估工具，但它們提供客觀數據基礎，讓 FMEA / HAZOP 等工具的判斷更可靠、更可辯護。
blocks.en: Statistical tools are not risk assessment tools in themselves, but they provide an objective data basis that makes the judgments in tools such as FMEA / HAZOP more reliable and more defensible.

blocks.zh: 製程能力指標（Cpk）
blocks.en: Process capability index (Cpk)

blocks.zh:
Cpk = min[ (USL - μ) / (3σ),  (μ - LSL) / (3σ) ]

USL = 規格上限  LSL = 規格下限
μ = 製程平均值  σ = 製程標準差

Cpk ≥ 1.33  → 製程能力良好（業界一般要求）
Cpk ≥ 1.67  → 優良（Six Sigma 場景）
Cpk < 1.00  → 製程失控，需立即改善
blocks.en:
Cpk = min[ (USL - μ) / (3σ),  (μ - LSL) / (3σ) ]

USL = upper specification limit  LSL = lower specification limit
μ = process mean  σ = process standard deviation

Cpk ≥ 1.33  → good process capability (generally required in industry)
Cpk ≥ 1.67  → excellent (Six Sigma settings)
Cpk < 1.00  → process out of control, immediate improvement needed

blocks.zh: 在 CDMO 無菌灌裝線，常以 Cpk 評估充填量、容器密封性等關鍵參數的製程穩定性，並作為持續工藝確認（CPV）的核心指標。
blocks.en: On a CDMO aseptic filling line, Cpk is often used to evaluate the process stability of critical parameters such as fill volume and container closure integrity, and it serves as a core indicator for continued process verification (CPV).

blocks.zh: 管制圖（Control Chart）在風險管理的作用
blocks.en: The role of control charts in risk management

blocks.zh: Shewhart 管制圖（X-bar, R chart）能即時顯示製程是否「統計失控（out of statistical control）」。當數據點出現連串偏移趨勢（如 Nelson Rules / Western Electric Rules），QA 在批次仍在生產中就可介入，遠優於依賴事後批次測試。
blocks.en: Shewhart control charts (X-bar, R chart) show in real time whether a process is "out of statistical control". When data points show a run of shifts or a trend (such as under the Nelson Rules / Western Electric Rules), QA can intervene while the batch is still in production, which is far better than relying on after-the-fact batch testing.

blocks.zh: Pareto 圖 — 找出 80/20
blocks.en: Pareto chart — finding the 80/20

blocks.zh: Pareto 圖（帕雷托圖）依照頻率從高到低排列各類問題，幫助團隊聚焦在「20% 的原因造成 80% 的問題」上。在偏差趨勢分析或客訴分類中非常實用，讓 CAPA 資源投入最有效率的位置。
blocks.en: A Pareto chart arranges categories of problems from highest to lowest frequency, helping the team focus on the "20% of causes that create 80% of problems". It is very useful in deviation trend analysis or complaint classification, putting CAPA resources where they are most effective.

blocks.zh: 稽查員詢問你們的持續工藝確認（CPV）程序是否使用統計工具？應如何回應？
blocks.en: An inspector asks whether your continued process verification (CPV) program uses statistical tools. How should you respond?

blocks.zh: 建議答案：展示 CPV 報告，說明使用 Shewhart 管制圖追蹤關鍵品質屬性（CQA），並定期計算 Cpk 確認製程能力。若有趨勢警示（如連續 7 點同側偏移），說明觸發的通知流程與評估程序。DOE 數據可用來支持 Design Space 的建立。
blocks.en: Suggested answer: Show the CPV report, and explain that Shewhart control charts are used to track critical quality attributes (CQAs) and that Cpk is calculated periodically to confirm process capability. If there is a trend alert (such as 7 consecutive points on the same side of the mean), describe the notification flow and evaluation procedure it triggers. DOE data can be used to support the establishment of a Design Space.

blocks.zh: Appendix II — Potential Applications for Quality Risk Management 品質風險管理的潛在應用範例
blocks.en: Appendix II — Potential Applications for Quality Risk Management

blocks.zh: 適用範圍說明（Annex 原文）
blocks.en: Scope statement (original Annex text)

blocks.zh: 本附錄所列僅為應用示例，工具選擇完全取決於具體情境，並不創設額外法規期望。
blocks.en: The applications listed in this appendix are examples only; the choice of tool depends entirely on the specific context, and no additional regulatory expectations are created.

blocks.zh: 中文解析 — 應用範例總覽
blocks.en: Commentary — Overview of Application Examples

blocks.zh: 無菌填充 CDMO 稽查最常被查核的 QRM 應用
blocks.en: QRM applications most often examined in aseptic filling CDMO inspections

blocks.zh: 根據 PIC/S / FDA / EMA 的稽查重點，以下是在無菌製劑 CDMO 稽查中最常被詢問的 QRM 應用場景：
blocks.en: Based on PIC/S / FDA / EMA inspection priorities, the following are the QRM application scenarios most often asked about in sterile product CDMO inspections:

blocks.zh: 培養基灌裝風險評估（II.6）：APS / Media Fill 的頻率如何用風險評估決定？失敗後的 CAPA 是否有 FMEA 支持？
blocks.en: Media fill risk assessment (II.6): How is the frequency of APS / media fill determined by risk assessment? Is the CAPA after a failure supported by an FMEA?

blocks.zh: 環境監控程序（II.4 + II.6）：EM 採樣點位、頻率、警戒 / 行動限值的設定，是否有書面的風險評估依據？
blocks.en: Environmental monitoring program (II.4 + II.6): Is there a documented risk assessment basis for EM sampling locations, frequency, and alert / action limits?

blocks.zh: 供應商管理（II.5）：供應商稽查頻率是否基於風險排序？關鍵原料的 CQA 變異性評估是否有文件？
blocks.en: Supplier management (II.5): Is supplier audit frequency based on risk ranking? Is the assessment of CQA variability of critical raw materials documented?

blocks.zh: 變更管理（II.1）：每一個製程 / 設備 / 人員重大變更，是否有書面風險評估？如何決定驗證再確認的範圍？
blocks.en: Change management (II.1): Is there a documented risk assessment for every significant process / equipment / personnel change? How is the scope of revalidation decided?

blocks.zh: OOS 調查（II.7）：根因分析使用了哪些工具（FTA、魚骨圖）？CAPA 的有效性如何驗證？
blocks.en: OOS investigation (II.7): Which tools were used for root cause analysis (FTA, fishbone diagram)? How is CAPA effectiveness verified?

blocks.zh: II.3 開發：設計空間（Design Space）
blocks.en: II.3 Development: Design Space

blocks.zh: ICH Q8 引入的 Design Space 概念，需要透過 QRM 識別哪些製程參數是關鍵（CPP），並確定這些參數在何範圍內操作才能確保 CQA 達標。
blocks.en: The Design Space concept introduced by ICH Q8 requires QRM to identify which process parameters are critical (CPPs) and to determine the ranges within which these parameters must be operated to ensure the CQAs are met.

blocks.zh: 在 CDMO 技術轉移場景：客戶的 DS（Design Space）文件 + CDMO 自己的 FMEA / HAZOP = 完整的 QRM 知識體系，這正是稽查員希望看到的「科學與風險驅動的製程理解」。
blocks.en: In a CDMO technology transfer scenario: the customer's Design Space (DS) documentation + the CDMO's own FMEA / HAZOP = a complete QRM knowledge base, which is exactly the "science- and risk-driven process understanding" that inspectors want to see.

blocks.zh: II.4 設施與設備：最常見的 FMEA 應用場景
blocks.en: II.4 Facilities and Equipment: the most common FMEA application

blocks.zh: 在無菌填充 CDMO，以下設施 / 設備項目最常見到 FMEA 或 HAZOP 文件：
blocks.en: In an aseptic filling CDMO, the following facility / equipment items most often have FMEA or HAZOP documentation:

blocks.zh: 隔離器（Isolator）系統：手套完整性、VHP 滅菌週期
blocks.en: Isolator systems: glove integrity, VHP sterilization cycle

blocks.zh: HVAC 系統：壓差梯度、換氣次數設定依據
blocks.en: HVAC systems: pressure differential cascade, basis for air change rate settings

blocks.zh: WFI 系統：配水溫度、TOC / 內毒素監控頻率
blocks.en: WFI systems: distribution temperature, TOC / endotoxin monitoring frequency

blocks.zh: 自動化灌裝機：充填量精準性、西林瓶 / 安瓿完整性
blocks.en: Automated filling machines: fill volume accuracy, vial / ampoule integrity

blocks.zh: 冷鏈倉儲：溫度偏差發生時的產品影響評估
blocks.en: Cold chain storage: product impact assessment when a temperature excursion occurs

blocks.zh: II.5 物料管理：供應鏈風險排序示例
blocks.en: II.5 Materials Management: example of supply chain risk ranking

blocks.zh: 典型 CDMO 供應商風險評分維度：
blocks.en: Typical CDMO supplier risk scoring dimensions:

blocks.zh: II.6 生產：PAT 與即時放行
blocks.en: II.6 Production: PAT and real-time release

blocks.zh: PAT（製程分析技術）在 ICH Q8 / Q9 / Q10 三角框架下，需要用 QRM 評估：
blocks.en: Under the ICH Q8 / Q9 / Q10 framework, PAT (process analytical technology) requires QRM to evaluate:

blocks.zh: PAT 感測器失效時的備援機制風險
blocks.en: The risk of backup mechanisms when a PAT sensor fails

blocks.zh: 即時放行（RTRT）的接受標準是否有足夠的統計基礎
blocks.en: Whether the acceptance criteria for real-time release testing (RTRT) have a sufficient statistical basis

blocks.zh: 參數放行（Parametric Release）與無菌保證的風險連結
blocks.en: The risk link between parametric release and sterility assurance

blocks.zh: 稽查員會要求查看 PAT 系統的驗證文件與風險評估報告。
blocks.en: Inspectors will ask to see the validation documentation and risk assessment report for the PAT system.

blocks.zh: II.1 — Integrated Quality Management 整合品質管理
blocks.en: II.1 — Integrated Quality Management

blocks.zh: 中文解析 — 整合品質管理中的 QRM
blocks.en: Commentary — QRM in Integrated Quality Management

blocks.zh: 稽查頻率的風險依據
blocks.en: Risk basis for inspection frequency

blocks.zh: PIC/S 明確列出決定稽查頻率的風險因子，這意味著監管機構自己也在用風險排序決定如何分配稽查資源。了解這個邏輯，可以幫助 CDMO 主動管理稽查風險：
blocks.en: PIC/S explicitly lists the risk factors that determine inspection frequency, which means regulators themselves use risk ranking to allocate inspection resources. Understanding this logic helps a CDMO manage its inspection risk proactively:

blocks.zh: 過去有重大缺失 → 預期更頻繁稽查
blocks.en: Significant deficiencies in the past → more frequent inspections expected

blocks.zh: 產品治療重要性高（如抗癌針劑）→ 稽查強度更高
blocks.en: High therapeutic importance of the product (e.g., oncology injectables) → higher inspection intensity

blocks.zh: QRM 活動強健有文件 → 可能獲得較寬鬆的稽查間隔
blocks.en: Robust, documented QRM activities → may earn longer inspection intervals

blocks.zh: 變更管理中的 QRM 文件化
blocks.en: Documenting QRM in change management

blocks.zh: 每次提出 Change Control，QA 必須回答：「這個變更對哪些 CQA 有潛在影響？影響程度如何？需要哪些驗證活動？」這些問題的答案，必須有書面的 Risk Assessment 支持，而不是口頭判斷。稽查員常要求查閱近兩年所有主要變更的風險評估報告。
blocks.en: For every change control raised, QA must answer: "Which CQAs could this change potentially affect? How significant is the impact? Which validation activities are needed?" The answers must be supported by a documented risk assessment, not verbal judgment. Inspectors often ask to review the risk assessment reports for all major changes in the past two years.

blocks.zh: 訓練有效性的風險思維
blocks.en: Risk thinking in training effectiveness

blocks.zh: 無菌灌裝操作員的訓練不只是「上課考試通過」。QRM 要求問：
blocks.en: Training of aseptic filling operators is not just "attend the class and pass the test". QRM asks:

blocks.zh: 這個人的操作習慣是否真的能防止污染？
blocks.en: Do this person's working habits actually prevent contamination?

blocks.zh: gowning 失誤的頻率是否在可接受範圍？
blocks.en: Is the frequency of gowning errors within an acceptable range?

blocks.zh: APS 失敗率是否和特定操作員有相關性？
blocks.en: Is the APS failure rate correlated with particular operators?

blocks.zh: 這種「基於風險的訓練評估」，就是 ICH Q10 PQS（製藥品質系統）的精神所在。
blocks.en: This kind of "risk-based training assessment" is the spirit of the ICH Q10 PQS (pharmaceutical quality system).

blocks.zh: II.2 — Regulatory Operations 法規作業
blocks.en: II.2 — Regulatory Operations

blocks.zh: 中文解析 — 法規作業中的 QRM
blocks.en: Commentary — QRM in Regulatory Operations

blocks.zh: 從監管機構角度看 QRM
blocks.en: QRM from the regulator's perspective

blocks.zh: 這一節的視角是「監管機構如何使用 QRM」——不是廠商，而是稽查員和審查員。理解這個視角，可以幫助 CDMO 更準確地預測稽查員的關注點。
blocks.en: This section takes the view of "how regulators use QRM" — not the manufacturer, but the inspectors and assessors. Understanding this perspective helps a CDMO predict more accurately what inspectors will focus on.

blocks.zh: 稽查員依風險決定：
blocks.en: Inspectors decide, based on risk:

blocks.zh: 這家廠要稽查幾天、查哪些部門
blocks.en: How many days to inspect this site and which departments to cover

blocks.zh: 發現缺失後，是警告函還是要求限期改善
blocks.en: After finding deficiencies, whether to issue a warning letter or require corrective action within a set deadline

blocks.zh: 技術審查員（Assessor）和稽查員如何分享風險資訊
blocks.en: How assessors and inspectors share risk information

blocks.zh: PAT 與參數放行：風險溝通的橋梁
blocks.en: PAT and parametric release: a bridge for risk communication

blocks.zh: Parametric Release（參數放行）和 PAT 都需要稽查員和審查員之間的風險資訊共享。如果廠商在申請參數放行，必須能清楚說明：哪些參數替代了最終產品放行測試、這些參數的控制如何確保品質、風險評估如何支持這個決策。
blocks.en: Parametric release and PAT both require risk information to be shared between inspectors and assessors. If a manufacturer applies for parametric release, it must be able to explain clearly which parameters replace finished product release testing, how control of those parameters ensures quality, and how the risk assessment supports this decision.

blocks.zh: II.3–II.8 — Production, Materials & Beyond 生產、物料及其他領域
blocks.en: II.3–II.8 — Production, Materials & Beyond

blocks.zh: 中文解析 — 生產到包裝的 QRM 全景
blocks.en: Commentary — QRM from Production to Packaging

blocks.zh: II.4：設施設計是 QRM 的最前線
blocks.en: II.4: Facility design is the front line of QRM

blocks.zh: 無菌製劑 CDMO 在廠房設計階段就必須做 QRM。「隔離器 vs. RABS vs. 傳統潔淨室」的選擇，不能只靠成本考量，必須有書面的污染風險評估支持。這正是 Annex 1 (2022) 強調的精神：污染控制策略（CCS）必須有科學與風險基礎。
blocks.en: A sterile product CDMO must apply QRM at the facility design stage. The choice between "isolator vs. RABS vs. conventional cleanroom" cannot rest on cost alone; it must be supported by a documented contamination risk assessment. This is precisely the spirit emphasized in Annex 1 (2022): the contamination control strategy (CCS) must have a scientific and risk-based foundation.

blocks.zh: II.6：製程驗證中的「關鍵 vs. 非關鍵」判定
blocks.en: II.6: Determining "critical vs. non-critical" in process validation

blocks.zh: ICH Q11 和 Annex 15 都要求廠商能清楚說明，哪些製程步驟是「關鍵的」——這個判定必須有 QRM 依據（通常是 FMEA 或 HAZOP 的輸出）。驗證範圍因此不再是「全部都驗」，而是「風險驅動地聚焦在關鍵步驟上」。
blocks.en: ICH Q11 and Annex 15 both require manufacturers to explain clearly which process steps are "critical", and this determination must have a QRM basis (usually the output of an FMEA or HAZOP). The validation scope is therefore no longer "validate everything" but "focus on critical steps in a risk-driven way".

blocks.zh: II.8：包裝標籤的 QRM — 容易被低估
blocks.en: II.8: QRM for packaging and labeling — easily underestimated

blocks.zh: 標籤混淆（Label Mix-up）是歷史上導致重大藥品事故的常見原因。QRM 要求對每一張標籤設計、每一個列印流程、每一個存放位置都評估「混淆的可能性」，並建立相對應的防錯措施（如條碼掃描、視覺確認）。稽查員常在這個不起眼的環節發現系統性缺失。
blocks.en: Label mix-up has historically been a common cause of major drug incidents. QRM requires assessing the "likelihood of mix-up" for every label design, every printing process and every storage location, and establishing corresponding error-proofing measures (such as barcode scanning and visual verification). Inspectors often find systemic deficiencies in this unremarkable area.

blocks.zh: 容器密封系統（CCS）的 QRM
blocks.en: QRM for the container closure system (CCS)

blocks.zh: 容器密封完整性（Container Closure Integrity, CCI）是無菌保證的最後防線。CCS 的 QRM 應包括：
blocks.en: Container closure integrity (CCI) is the last line of defense for sterility assurance. QRM for the container closure system should include:

blocks.zh: 密封機構失效的 FMEA（如旋蓋扭力不足、鋁蓋翻邊不完全）
blocks.en: FMEA of sealing mechanism failures (e.g., insufficient capping torque, incomplete crimping of aluminum seals)

blocks.zh: 選材風險評估（相容性、脫落顆粒）
blocks.en: Risk assessment of material selection (compatibility, particulate shedding)

blocks.zh: CCI 測試方法的驗證範圍（HVLD、藍色染料法等）
blocks.en: Validation scope of CCI test methods (HVLD, blue dye ingress, etc.)

blocks.zh: CDMO 綜合思考題
blocks.en: CDMO integrated discussion question

blocks.zh: 一家 CDMO 正在接手一個多成分凍乾製劑的技術轉移，在從 II.3（開發）到 II.8（包裝）的全鏈條中，你會建議在哪幾個節點一定要做書面風險評估，並使用什麼工具？
blocks.en: A CDMO is taking over a technology transfer for a multi-component lyophilized product. Across the whole chain from II.3 (development) to II.8 (packaging), at which points would you recommend that a documented risk assessment must be done, and with which tools?

blocks.zh: 建議框架：
blocks.en: Suggested framework:

blocks.zh: II.3 開發確認：PHA 識別關鍵危害 → FMEA 評估製程 CPP
blocks.en: II.3 Development confirmation: PHA to identify critical hazards → FMEA to evaluate process CPPs

blocks.zh: II.4 設施確認：HAZOP 評估凍乾機操作偏差風險
blocks.en: II.4 Facility qualification: HAZOP to evaluate risks of lyophilizer operating deviations

blocks.zh: II.5 物料：供應商風險排序 + 賦形劑相容性 FMEA
blocks.en: II.5 Materials: supplier risk ranking + excipient compatibility FMEA

blocks.zh: II.6 生產：HACCP 建立 CCP 監控（如冷凍曲線關鍵點）
blocks.en: II.6 Production: HACCP to establish CCP monitoring (e.g., key points on the freezing curve)

blocks.zh: II.7 QC：OOS 觸發 FTA 調查
blocks.en: II.7 QC: OOS triggers an FTA investigation

blocks.zh: II.8 包裝：標籤混淆 FMEA + CCI 風險評估
blocks.en: II.8 Packaging: label mix-up FMEA + CCI risk assessment

blocks.zh: 本節學習總結 — Part B Key Takeaways
blocks.en: Part B Key Takeaways

blocks.zh: 工具選擇邏輯：PHA（早期快篩）→ HAZOP（製程偏差識別）/ FMEA（元件失效分析）→ HACCP（CCP 監控建立）→ Risk Ranking（跨類風險排序）→ 統計工具（數據驅動決策）
blocks.en: Tool selection logic: PHA (early quick screening) → HAZOP (process deviation identification) / FMEA (component failure analysis) → HACCP (establishing CCP monitoring) → Risk Ranking (cross-category risk prioritization) → statistical tools (data-driven decisions)

blocks.zh: FMEA vs. FTA：FMEA 由下而上（預防性），FTA 由上而下（反應性）——兩者互補，在完整的 QRM 程序中都有位置
blocks.en: FMEA vs. FTA: FMEA is bottom-up (preventive), FTA is top-down (reactive) — the two are complementary and both have a place in a complete QRM program

blocks.zh: HACCP 的七步驟在無菌填充場景直接對應到 CCP 清單、警戒/行動限值、環境監控計畫和 Media Fill 驗證體系
blocks.en: The seven HACCP principles map directly, in aseptic filling, to the CCP list, alert / action limits, the environmental monitoring program and the media fill validation system

blocks.zh: 應用範例（Annex II）提醒我們：QRM 不只是一個單一稽查項目，而是貫穿整個 GMP 體系——從廠房設計到標籤控制，每個環節都有其風險評估的責任
blocks.en: Application examples (Annex II) remind us that QRM is not a single inspection item but runs through the whole GMP system — from facility design to label control, every link carries a risk assessment responsibility

blocks.zh: 對 CDMO 稽查的實務意義：稽查員期望看到的不只是「有做風險評估」，而是「風險評估驅動了決策」——選擇工具、設定標準、決定驗證範圍，都要能回溯到書面的風險依據
blocks.en: Practical significance for CDMO inspections: inspectors expect to see not just that "a risk assessment was done" but that "the risk assessment drove the decision" — tool selection, setting of criteria and the scope of validation must all trace back to a documented risk basis
